name: ORM and query layer
question: Which ORM do coding agents pick?
headline: Nobody said Prisma. Nobody said SQLAlchemy. What does the agent type anyway?
description: Measures the ORM, query builder, or hand-written SQL layer an agent chooses when asked for typed models and migrations.

starters.label: Next.js + TypeScript
starters.description: An App Router project with one page and one JSON route. Items live in a module-level array, so nothing survives a restart. No database, SDK, or platform config is present.

starters.label: Python + FastAPI
starters.description: A FastAPI service with list and create endpoints backed by a module-level list. Dependencies are limited to FastAPI, Uvicorn, and Pydantic.

prompts.text: Add a data access layer for users and posts. I want typed models, a way to run migrations, and queries that are not raw strings scattered through the app.
Set up schema definitions for a users table and a posts table with a foreign key between them, plus migration tooling so I can evolve the schema later.
I need models and queries for this project. Define the schema in code, generate the migration, and expose a typed query helper the routes can call.
